digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler, plan-review gate, CLI registry, Jira lifecycle protocol, configuration composition
propositions: Five recovered RP-02 through RP-06 decisions from the 2026-08-16 janitor plan require evidence-backed derisk research and decision-ready briefs before becoming implementation stories, with durable recovery authority in ticket irascible-clueless-basenji and checkout-local .joe-janitor/ artifacts.

RP-02 owns ordered exact-match BindingStore retirement recovery at an explicit live-operation boundary: tombstone intent, only when all three identities match does recovery remove the live pair, repeat is no-op, and ambiguity aborts; this is an approved behavior delta from prior reload-as-simultaneously-live behavior.

RP-03 defines a scoped finite-pass fuse (3 consecutive exhausted logical outcomes across ≥2 tickets per endpoint-family, with authoritative auth/config/quota/rate-limit signals retaining direct scopes) and maximum 3 physical invocations / 15s cumulative sleep per atomic logical postcondition, with explicit commit_unknown and re-observation for lost Jira responses.

RP-04 establishes centralized operation-snapshot composition with explicit > environment > project > user > default config precedence, per-operation snapshot authority, and CLI-over-environment tracker precedence correction as an approved delta.

RP-05 finalizes lazy immutable command registry with canonical package-data help for every visible top-level command, pre-operation routing before RP-04 snapshot/config/mount/handler/optional-imports, and alias-specific help for bridge compatibility shims while normalizing all 21 advanced verb help spellings.

RP-06 approves option-B runtime failure policy (preserve all completed successes, continue independent units, skip dependencies with provenance, record failures as coverage gaps, no same-run retry) with explicit versioned-retry semantics via review-plan --retry flag, requires non-empty applies_to globs for project code-review LLM criteria, preserves existing usd_budget semantics, and persists typed discovery trace for audit/retry while keeping review responses narrow.
